content.title: Drive Overview
content.content: PowerFlex 755 is a high-performance AC drive (0.75-2000 HP). Features: integrated EtherNet/IP, DeviceLogix (embedded logic), Safe Torque Off (STO SIL 3), positioning/indexing, predictive diagnostics, automatic device configuration (ADC). Frame sizes 1-10. Input: 200-690V AC.

content.title: DeviceLogix Embedded Logic
content.content: Programmable logic inside the drive (no PLC needed). 50 function blocks: boolean, math, compare, timer, counter, latch, multiplexer. 1ms scan time. Access to drive parameters, I/O, network data. Programmed via DriveExplorer or CCW. Use for: local control, sequencing, protection logic, pump/ fan staging.

content.title: Integrated Safety
content.content: Safe Torque Off (STO) SIL 3/PLe standard. Optional: Safe Speed Monitor (SSM), Safe Stop 1 (SS1), Safe Brake Control (SBC), Safe Direction (SDI). Safety option module 20-750-S. Safety configuration via DriveExplorer. Safety signature. Reaction time: <10ms for STO.

content.title: Positioning & Indexing
content.content: Point-to-point positioning with encoder feedback. Modes: absolute, relative, registration, homing. Profile: trapezoidal, S-curve. Electronic gearing (follower ratio). Camming with profile tables. Encoder: incremental, absolute (Hiperface, EnDat, SSI). Position capture (latch).

content.title: Predictive Diagnostics
content.content: Drive health monitoring: heatsink temp, bus capacitor life, fan hours, bearing hours, IGBT thermal model. Remaining life estimation. Alarm thresholds configurable. Data logged to internal memory. Access via EtherNet/IP or web server. Integration with FactoryTalk Analytics.

content.title: Communication & Configuration
content.content: Dual-port EtherNet/IP (DLR, linear, star). Device Level Ring (DLR) for redundancy. Embedded web server for configuration. ADC (Automatic Device Configuration) from Logix controller. Parameter groups: motor, speed, torque, position, I/O, communication, safety, application.

content.title: G120 Overview
content.content: Modular drive system: Control Unit (CU) + Power Module (PM). Power range 0.37-250 kW. Control Units: CU250S-2 (EtherNet/IP), CU250S-2 DP (PROFIBUS), CU250S-2 PN (PROFINET). Safety Integrated: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (SIL 2/PL d). Basic Positioner (EPos) included.

content.title: Startdrive Commissioning Tool
content.content: Integrated in TIA Portal. Wizard-based commissioning. Motor identification (rotating/standstill). Speed controller optimization. Safety commissioning with validation. Trace function for diagnostics. Parameter comparison. Offline/online modes. Project download/upload.

content.title: Safety Integrated
content.content: Functions: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (up to 4 speed stages). Safe Brake Test. PROFIsafe via PROFINET/PROFIBUS. Safety parameters password-protected. Forced dormant error detection. Safety logbook. Acceptance test wizard with report generation.

content.title: Basic Positioner (EPos)
content.content: Positioning modes: absolute, relative, referencing, flying referencing, jog. Traversing blocks (up to 64). Traversing profiles: trapezoidal, S-curve. Jerk limitation. Direct setpoint specification (MDI). Modulo offset for rotary axes. Encoder: HTL/TTL, DRIVE-CLiQ, SSI.

content.title: Fieldbus Communication
content.content: PROFINET (IRT/RT), PROFIBUS DP, EtherNet/IP, CANopen, USS, Modbus RTU. Telegram selection (standard/safety). Shared device. Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP). Isochronous mode for motion. Web server for diagnostics. OPC UA server (CU250S-2 PN).

content.title: Altivar Process Overview
content.content: Process drives for pumps, fans, compressors (0.75-2500 kW). Services-oriented: energy monitoring, asset management, process optimization. Embedded Ethernet (dual port). Web server. Device Type Manager (DTM) for FDT frameworks. Cybersecurity: Achilles Level 2.

content.title: Embedded Services
content.content: Energy: consumption, efficiency, kWh, CO2. Asset: operating hours, starts, temperature, vibration. Process: flow, pressure, level control (PID). Pump: multi-pump staging, anti-jam, pipe fill, dry run. Fan: stall detection, filter monitoring. Compressor: load/unload, sequencing.

content.title: Device Type Manager (DTM)
content.content: FDT/DTM standard for configuration. Works with: EcoStruxure Control Expert, PACTware, FieldCare, other FDT frames. Online/offline parameterization. Diagnostics: oscilloscope, trending, alarm history. Firmware update via DTM. DTMs available for all Altivar models.
